children: Centerspace entered into an amendment to its Agreement and Plan of Merger with Independence Realty to adopt an alternative merger structure. The change adds IRT Merger Sub as a party and revises the Company Merger so that Centerspace will merge into IRT Merger Sub, which will survive as a subsidiary of Independence Realty. The parties also waived any representation inaccuracies caused solely by this structural change. The transaction remains subject to customary approvals and the filing of a Form S-4 and joint proxy statement.
